title: build.event
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). One build-phase event for the phone feed: a test result, a revealed flaw, a drawn anomaly card, a review opening or passing, a rework, a deadline slip, a Lessons Learned bonus. The decision itself, if any, is a separate vote.

subjectId.description: Test id, anomaly card id, review id, part category id or lesson id; null when none.

deltas.description: Dashboard changes caused by the event; empty when none.

factId.description: Related fact to show; null when none.

BuildEventKind.description: Kind of build-phase event shown in the phone feed.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

Delta.description: One Readiness Dashboard metric after a hypothetical or applied change, computed by the host (§6.3, §14.3 "IF CHOSEN").

value.description: Value of the metric after the change.

delta.description: Change against the current build (value after − value before).

MetricId.description: Readiness Dashboard metric (§6.3). The unit is part of the identifier.

Rating.description: Colour class of a value or delta (§14.4).

TextRef.description: Reference to localised player-visible text. The protocol never carries free display text: `key` is a key of `data/strings/<lang>.json`, and `args` supplies substitution values. Receivers format numbers and units locally.

args.description: Substitution values by placeholder name. String values must themselves be data ids or string-table keys, never user text.
